title: Validity of a configuration record
statement: Let $k,n,s$ be natural numbers, let $Q,T$ be types, and let $F$ be a finite list of finite fields over the record alphabet for states $Q$ and tags $T$. The record $F$ is valid if there exist a Boolean input $x$ of length $n$, a configuration $c$ on $x$ whose work-tape heads lie in the window of radius $s$, and a tag $\tau$ in $T$ such that the configuration record of $c$ with tag $\tau$ is $F$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a finite list of finite fields over the record alphabet
There exists a Boolean input of length $n$
caveat: The definition of $\mathrm{InWindow}(s)$ is not included, so the window condition is rendered using its apparent meaning.
